title: The probe gate: one lesson measured in pairs on the local solver (harness learning, H3)
request: The owner chose, before sleeping, to build the probe gate and run a tiny live probe (one lesson, three homeworks, with and without) on the local model, at no cost.
spec: Plan H3: for a draft lesson, paired runs on learning variants with and without it, the local solver only, at least three repeats, the grader's score; probed only if the mean paired gain is above zero and no solved variant regresses; counters by code; the sealed set never read.
plan: pair each learning variant without and with the one lesson, shown in the first user message
grade both by code and move the counters once per pair
promote from draft to probed by a gate fixed before the run
reuse the pilot's attempts as the arm without the lesson where nothing but time differs
keep every attempt whole, resumable after a pause

decisions.decision: The pilot's attempts serve as the arm without the lesson when model, budget, tools and rules match
decisions.why: on this laptop a homework costs half an hour; the pilot is exactly that arm

decisions.decision: A tiny run moves the counters and never the status
decisions.why: three pairs cannot show a lesson helps; the gate asks nine pairs with three repeats a variant

decisions.decision: A homework the server broke is marked invalid and done again
decisions.why: a broken instrument is neither the lesson's nor the model's result

decisions.decision: A hosted model may run the same homeworks once, capped, for comparison; never as the learning loop's solver
decisions.why: comparing Claude with the local model on the same homeworks tells a weak model from misleading evidence; its runs stay silver

change: dclab_rnd/learning/probe.py (new); dclab_rnd/learning/__main__.py (probe, a shared local-client check); dclab_rnd/learning/pilot.py (a broken homework marked invalid); dclab_rnd/learning/scoreboard.py (probe results named apart); tests/test_learning_h3_probe.py (new). Later: --limit for the pilot and the probe (exit 3 while more remain). Later: --hosted --yes --cap-eur for the pilot and the probe (a total cap for the run, max_eur a homework, the served model named and priced before any spend).

findings.defect: a homework the server broke blocked the probe forever and would be filed as the model failing
findings.scenario: the server stopped mid-run: the session failed with no step, yet a grade and a row were written; every rerun found the row and stayed invalid; the store read the grade as a failed solve
findings.fix: an attempt that broke before the model answered is marked invalid at once, so a rerun does it again and training never counts it
findings.impact: a stopped server would end a probe and poison the failed set

findings.defect: a pair could mix two time budgets
findings.scenario: a probe paused after the arm without the lesson at 45 minutes, resumed at 15: the pair compared 45 against 15
findings.cause: a row did not record its budget and the lookup did not compare it
findings.fix: each row keeps its budget, and a done homework is found only under the same budget (and the same lesson and lineage for the arm with it)
findings.impact: an unfair pair counted as evidence

findings.defect: the gate promoted a lesson with no repeat although the plan asks three
findings.scenario: nine variants, one pair each, could promote a lesson
findings.fix: promotion also needs three repeats of each variant; written into the gate before any live probe
findings.impact: a lesson promoted on one noisy draw a variant
alternatives: state the departure from the plan in the gate

findings.defect: a promotion was tried on a lesson the same run's counts had retired
findings.scenario: earlier probes counted it harmful twice; this run's counts reached the retirement line yet its mean gain was positive: the status change was refused and no result was saved
findings.cause: the status was read before the counts moved
findings.fix: the status is read again after the counts and a promotion is tried only from draft
findings.impact: a probe that ends in an error with its counts written

findings.defect: a pilot attempt made under older tools or rules could serve as the arm without the lesson
findings.scenario: a change to the intern's rules after the pilot: the pair would compare old code against new
findings.cause: reuse checked the model and budget only
findings.fix: reuse needs the attempt's tools and rules hashes to equal today's
findings.impact: a pair that measures a code change, not the lesson

findings.defect: one process doing homework after homework grew until swap filled the disk
findings.scenario: the resumed pilot, fourth homework done, fifth under way: swap at 10 GB, the disk at 1.7 GB free; stopping the process and the model gave back 8 GB at once
findings.cause: the process kept what each homework loaded; the operating system swapped it to disk
findings.fix: a limit of new homeworks a process, the command exits with 3 when more remain, and a loop runs one homework a process with the disk checked before each
findings.impact: a night's run stopped by a full disk
alternatives: find what each homework leaves in memory
findings.open: what each homework leaves in memory is not yet found

outcome: A lesson can now be measured on the local solver in fair pairs: shown only in the first user message, graded by code, counted once, promoted only by a gate fixed before the run; a broken homework is done again and never counts.
lessons: Put every condition that makes two runs comparable in the row that finds them again.
Read a state again after the step that can change it, before acting on it.
risks: three repeats of three variants is about nine hours a lesson on this laptop
